shaSeparation.note: R3.0F F1 candidate branch SHA convention. headSha is filled at anchor commit; integrationSha at Train merge.

contractEnforcements.engineScope: renderer/js/r3-0f-migration-engine.js exports createMigrationEngine({backend, registry, ...}) → { detect, plan, migrate, journal, envelope, knownStores }. Default registry covers cases / sessions / r3_0e_experiments / r3_0e_outcomes / r3_0e_timelines / r3_0e_followupLinks. Backend-agnostic: works against the live R3.0B MemoryBackend / IndexedDBBackend transact surface. F1 introduces no new IndexedDB object stores; all six target stores already exist or are created by the live store modules on first write.
contractEnforcements.failClosed: Future-version records REJECTED (UNSUPPORTED_FUTURE_VERSION). Malformed records (non-object / sparse array / bad schemaVersion) REJECTED with closed reasonCode enum. Hostile inputs (Proxy / accessors / symbols / non-enumerables / __proto__ pollution / hostile toJSON / cycles / oversized records) stripped by structuredClone → JSON deep-clone input firewall. Migrator throwing → MIGRATOR_THREW. Migrator returning non-ok-boolean → failed. Migrator returning version > target → POST_MIGRATION_INVALID. Backend.transact() rejection → BACKEND_REJECTED + no partial write (per-store atomic batch). ENVELOPE_VERSION_MISMATCH refuses when persisted state envelope.engineVersion exceeds engine's known version.
contractEnforcements.idempotency: Running migrate() against an already-at-target store is a no-op (zero writes, status='no-op'). Re-running migrate() after a successful migration is also a no-op (deterministic).
contractEnforcements.noProducerAttestation: Engine NEVER fabricates producer attestation. The migrated record handed to backend.put has Object.prototype as its prototype, is NOT frozen, and the live store re-validates on subsequent read via its own contract path (R3.0B case-store sanitizeForStorage / R3.0E store .validateXxxShape).
contractEnforcements.appendOnlyJournal: Migration journal lives at meta['__r3_0f_migration_journal__']. Bounded ring buffer (default 256 entries); compaction increments state.lifetimeJournalDropped. JOURNAL_OVERFLOW gate inside a single migrate() halts at 4× maxJournalEntries to prevent runaway fill. Each entry is deep-frozen and validates against contract.validateJournalEntry().
contractEnforcements.noAuthorityCrossStore: Migration of one record does NOT touch another record in any other store. Secondary indexes (caseIndex / sessionIndex / r3_0e_experimentsIndex / r3_0e_outcomesIndex / r3_0e_followupLinksByCase) are NOT rebuilt by the engine — they are owned by the live stores and are re-validated next time the live store reads them.
contractEnforcements.r3bSchemaUntouched: The R3.0B persistence modules (case-record-schema.js / storage-backend.js / schema-migration.js / case-store.js / session-store.js / case-library-viewmodel.js) are NOT modified by F1. The case- and session-migrators are thin literal-require wrappers delegating to the existing schema-migration.js.
contractEnforcements.literalRequiresOnly: Engine + migrators use literal-string require specifiers only. Avoids triggering scripts/check-r3-phase-no-consumer.js PROD_SUSPECTED_DYNAMIC_PHASE_REQUIRE heuristic against other phase scans.
contractEnforcements.stateFloors: F1 unlocks runtimeConsumersAllowed=true (engine consumes contracts/r3.0f/) and algorithmsAllowed=true (step migrators are algorithms). uiAllowed and featureRegistryActivationAllowed remain false (F3/F6 floor). R3.0B case-record schema NOT modified.

featureRegistryState.note: F1 does NOT touch the feature registry. R3.0C/D/E activations remain in their state; the engine itself does NOT register a feature node.

crossPhaseGate.note: R3.0E reached E5_ACTIVATION at Train HEAD 49bdaad. F1 may advance.

note: R3.0F F1 establishes the unified migration engine and per-store migrators. No version bump (1.4.0 unchanged). No tag, no release. The engine is invokable from the Electron renderer via globalThis.R3_0F_MigrationEngine.createMigrationEngine({backend, ...}) but is NOT yet wired to the boot path — that activation happens at F6_RELEASE per cross-phase rule. F1 ships the engine + tests so the F2/F3 checkpoints have a stable migration foundation to build on.
